arabic text: Zahra ki andheri turbat pe kab shamma jalaane aaoge
english translation text: O avenger, when will you come and light a lamp upon your mother's grave?

arabic text: Tooti huwi kabro ko mawla, kis roz banaane aaoge
english translation text: O Maula, on what day will you rebuild the broken graves?

arabic text: Beshir ki nani mayat ko turbat se nikala tha jisne\nkab uske lashe ko mawla\nneze pe uthaane aaoge
english translation text: He who removed the tiny body of the infant from its grave—\nwhen, O Maula, will you raise his body\nupon the spear?

arabic text: hai chaar baras ki ek zahra zindaan me sadiyon se qaidi\nkab baytul huzn se tum usko\naazaad karane aaoge
english translation text: A four-year-old Zahra has been imprisoned for centuries within the dungeon;\nwhen will you free her\nfrom the House of Sorrows?

arabic text: dhaya roza hadi ka, dekha hai ujarta samara\njo daagh mile hain ghaybat mein\nkab unko dikhaane aaoge
english translation text: The shrine of Hadi was destroyed, and Samarra was seen in ruins;\nthe wounds received during the occultation—\nwhen will you reveal them?

arabic text: woh shaam or kufa ke raste, woh naaqo se girte bache\nhai kon kahaan per dafn huwa\nkab naam bataane aaoge
english translation text: Those roads of Shaam and Kufa, those children falling from the camels—\nwho was buried where?\nWhen will you tell their names?

arabic text: maasuma e qum or mola raza hum shakle payamber or sughra\nyeh bhayi behn hai bichre huwe\nkab unko milaane aaoge
english translation text: Masuma of Qum and Maula Raza, the likeness of the Prophet and Sughra—\nthese brothers and sisters remain separated;\nwhen will you reunite them?

arabic text: beton ke janaazon per akbar akbar ke loye jo roti hai\nkab ujri huwi un maaon ko\ninsaaf dilaane aaoge
english translation text: The mothers who weep 'Akbar, Akbar' over the bodies of their sons—\nwhen will you bring justice\nto those devastated mothers?
